title: rbac v2: enforce KMS region pinning and harden audit logging for Private deployments
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning at RBAC v2 evaluation time and add stricter audit logging for Private/VPC installs. No customer-facing API changes; internal policy and logging hardening only.
description:
Context: Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) have varying KMS region/residency requirements. RBAC v2 introduced flexible policy conditions, but we observed gaps where KMS-backed secrets could be referenced without enforcing region residency in the policy evaluator. This PR enforces KMS region pinning at policy-evaluation time and hardens audit logging so every KMS key use records the resolved region, policy decision context, and tenant ID for post-incident forensics.

Motivation: Prevent misconfiguration that could allow cross-region KMS usage contrary to customer residency constraints and improve auditability for security/compliance reviews.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds KMS region pinning check to the RBAC v2 policy evaluator: policies can now specify kms.region == <region|any> and the evaluator validates keys referenced by resources/requests.
- Extends audit log schema to include kms_key_id, kms_region_resolved, policy_decision_snippet, and tenant_id.
- Updates Private installer hooks and the runtime config to include an explicit kms.region_residency setting for clusters.
- Adds integration tests that spin up a minimal Private control-plane, mock KMS endpoints for eu-west-1 and us-west-2, and validate both allow/deny paths and logging fields.
- Adds a migration shim for existing RBAC v2 policies: unspecified KMS region defaults to cluster residency mode (audit-only initially), with a feature flag to opt-in to strict enforcement.
- Documentation updates (rbac policy docs + private deployment hardening guide) and changelog entry.

Checklist: 
- [x] RBAC evaluator changes implemented
- [x] Audit schema + export implemented
- [x] Private installer config updated
- [x] Integration tests added
- [x] Docs updated
- [x] Feature-flagged rollout path defined

Testing and CI:
- Unit tests for policy evaluator (new table-driven cases)
- Integration test matrix: allowed(==region), denied(mismatch), audit-only(default)
- Manual verification against local Private environment and mocked KMS endpoints

Rollout plan:
1) Merge behind feature flag (rbac_v2_kms_region_enforcement=false)
2) Deploy to staging and enable audit-only migration shim; monitor for policy violations and false positives for 2 weeks
3) Enable enforcement in staging, run integration smoke tests, then enable progressively in CANARY private clusters
4) Full rollout after 1 week of canary monitoring

Backout: Toggle feature flag off; migrate any policies flagged as violation to explicit region pinned rules.

Related: ENG-1423 (policy evaluator refactor), SEC-88 (KMS residency requirements), design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1423/rbac-v2-kms-region-pinning-design (internal).
